payload.artist_html: Minyoung Son, Yuong-Nam Lee​, Badamkhatan Zorigt, Yoshitsugu Kobayashi, Jin-Young Park, Sungjin Lee, Su-Hwan Kim & Kang Young Lee
payload.credit_html: (2022). "A new juvenile Yamaceratops (Dinosauria, Ceratopsia) from the Javkhlant Formation (Upper Cretaceous) of Mongolia". PeerJ 10: e13176. DOI:10.7717/peerj.13176. PMID 35402094. PMC: 8992648.
payload.description_html: Skeleton of Yamaceratops dorngobiensis (MPC-D 100/553) in right dorsolateral view. (A) Photograph; (B) Interpretive drawing. Bones are bounded by solid lines and colored beige; the matrix is gray. Shaded areas represent the broken surface of bones. Abbreviations: cd, caudal vertebrae; dr, dorsal ribs; dv, dorsal vertebrae; f, femur; fi, fibula; h, humerus; L, bone on the left side; p, isolated parietal; pp, pedal phalanges; R, bone on the right side; ra, radius; sk, skull; sv, sacral vertebrae; ti, tibia; u, ulna; il, ilium; is, ischium.
